text:
Maya Chen: 12 minutes to go. Quick checklist: stream health, local recorder, captions, and slide parity? Any red flags?
Lin (SRE): Recorder reporting healthy checksums. Saw brief NIC packet drops earlier on av-switch; moved presenter VLAN to spare port.
Devon - AV: Cam 2 driver threw a warning in rehearsal, rolled back firmware and set to manual focus. If Cam2 drops, cut to Cam B (hotkey F2).
Lena - Eng (remote): I'm remote and seeing a 1.2s audio delay on NDI feed. If it gets worse I'll dial in via phone.
Maya Chen: Noted. Priya, which slide version are we on?
Priya Gomez: v9-final. I removed a customer quote per Legal. Link posted in #resources. Presenters, please confirm v9.
Chris - CEO: I'll keep remarks <7min. Planning to mention Dedicated pilot (+ feedback loop) and hiring priorities.
Maya Chen: Order tweak: leadership -> infra -> customer Qs earlier (because infra might overrun).
Lin (SRE): If encoder CPU spikes, quick recover commands:
```
sudo systemctl restart av-encoder
# check logs
journalctl -u av-encoder -n 100 --no-pager
```
Devon - AV: Backup capture plan: if local recorder stalls, switch HDMI passthrough to recorder-B and start manual capture:
```
ssh recorder-b
/usr/local/bin/start_capture --label allhands-2869998888
```
recorder-bot: Local recording started. Upload target: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2869998888/session.mp4. Will retry on auth errors.
caption-bot: Auto-captions live. Current latency ~2.8s. Human captioner on standby if latency >5s.
Maya Chen: Heads-up: last week recorder upload failed with TokenExpired. Lin, can you confirm token TTL?
Lin (SRE): Had TTL at 1h; bumped it to 12h for the upload service and rotated keys. recorder-bot should succeed now.
deploy-bot: Minor canary finishing in ~3m; will pause on memory > 80% for inference-prod.
Priya Gomez: Queueing two live Qs: 1) Dedicated SLA GA timing, 2) How Optimize affects token pricing. Adding to Q doc.
Chris - CEO: I'll answer the timing high-level; Product can handle pricing details in the AMA.
Lena - Eng (remote): If my NDI gets flaky, I'll post here and join via phone. I'll also upload slides from my side in case of share issues.
Devon - AV: Quick OBS restart if the capture freezes:
```
sudo systemctl restart obs.service || sudo pkill -9 obs && nohup /usr/bin/obs >/tmp/obs.log 2>&1 &
```
Maya Chen: Presenters, use wired ethernet, mute when not speaking. If Zoom audio degrades, we'll post YouTube link and continue.
Priya Gomez: Legal confirmed slide 7 logos removed; v9 is approved. Also, request a 30s highlight clip of the Dedicated pilot mention  I'll timestamp during the call.
Lin (SRE): Small note: caption host NTP drift was the cause last time; I added a cron fix to sync every 5m.
caption-bot: If auto captions degrade beyond threshold, will post: "Captions degraded; switching to human captioner. SRT will be attached post-call"
Maya Chen: Any other blockers?
Devon - AV: All clear here. Camera batteries charged, backup HDMI cables at the ready.
recorder-bot: Upload queued. Will post link when transfer completes.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Final: I'll post the final speaker order and pin the stream-fallback runbook. See you in the room. :thumbsup:
